title: Kissed Tunisian Skewers with Chinese Long Beans
description: Salty, chewy, and energizing - a delicious Tunisian dish featuring Chinese long beans.
instructions: Soak the cedar planks in water for 30 minutes before using.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the Chinese long beans, chili flakes, garlic, salt, black pepper, paprika, cumin, and red pepper flakes onto the soaked cedar planks, leaving some space between each piece.
Brush the olive oil and lemon juice onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
